finding: Removing direct text cross-attention from world rows alone does not restore goal invariance: all three windows retain nonzero future-world differences. The residual is consistent with goal carried through contextualized action rows and then read by world rows; the corrected fixed-action world cut removes text from the action/value carriers as well.
scope: Three real image/state windows, fixed recorded 16-step actions, official two-step sampler; ablation only, not the primary repair.
